simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB M3503 revision B board (chips/m3503.py, run_dump_hd8150_starlight_2348_app_starts.py, run_dump_hd8150_starlight_2348_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3511D 1.1.1") runs from flash using CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF before relocating to DDR, prints "CH455 panel init OK!", writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 135 / 134, parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA141A7DC, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") and maincode(AV) ("10030A002348", 12.76 MB) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores ("MC: APP  init ok", main EBase 0x80002000, SEE running at 0xA6000200 with EBase 0x86002001).  The application prints "---led 455 attach OK--" and updates the CH455 panel, initialises hs_config_init and userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog on GMA layer 0.

desc: Amiko HD8150 (System ID 10030A00) firmware 2.3.48 Starlight by Dekolte (2016-2-18) for the Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the ALi M3511D / M3503 rev B SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.
Uses an XIP CacheAsRam bootloader ("M3511D 1.1.1"), dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" firmware at 0xA6000200, an Airoha AV2026 DVB-S2 tuner, and a 4-digit CH455 LED front panel on GPIO 135 (SCL) / 134 (SDA).
